LESSON: BUDDHIST VIHAAR IN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Worship 4.1 Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism (8 lessons) • Paying homage • t
Topic 4.2: Buddhist Vihaar in Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Buddhist Vihaar in Africa, part of Worship 4.1 Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism (8 lessons) • Paying homage • t in Grade 6 General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to visit a place of worship? 2. What is the importance of the features found in a Buddhist temple?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. name practices and ceremonies held in a Buddhist Vihaar,

2. collect pictures of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa from magazines/newspapers/digital devices,

3. discuss with peers the different features of Buddhist Vihaar,

4. create a montage using photos from the places of worship,

5. visit places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times,

6. use digital devices to locate the Buddhist Vihaar in Kenya,

7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching draw and colour the Buddhist Vihaar,

8. visit a Buddhist Vihaar to witness ceremonies, architecture and other important features. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. name practices and ceremonies held in a Buddhist Vihaar,
2. collect pictures of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa from magazines/newspapers/digital devices,
3. discuss with peers the different features of Buddhist Vihaar,
4. create a montage using photos from the places of worship,
5. visit places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times,
6. use digital devices to locate the Buddhist Vihaar in Kenya,
7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching draw and colour the Buddhist Vihaar,
8. visit a Buddhist Vihaar to witness ceremonies, architecture and other important features. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Buddhist Vihaar in Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: Learner interacts with technology when using digital devices to locate the Buddhist Vihaar in Kenya.

• Self-Efficacy: Learner gains confidence when creating a montage using photos from the places of worship.

Values:
Unity: Learner enhances cooperation when collecting pictures of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Learner enhances social cohesion when visiting places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Social Studies:

• Learner can relate the skills of creating a montage using photos from the places of worship, draw and colour the Buddhist

Vihaar to the skills of creating a montage learnt in Creative Arts.
